roles.name: 주모 / 구미호
roles.target: 주모 · 농밀한 구미호 — A mature adult Korean woman in her late thirties to forties, secretly an alluring fox spirit disguised as a tavern hostess in a Korean dark fantasy drama. Magnetically seductive and languid, confident knowing smile, measured lingering vowels and gently caressing phrase endings. She draws a listener closer with a spellbinding voice and concealed danger.
